name: modoo-today-skills
description: Search, inspect and read agent skills from the modoo.today skills catalog with six read-only tools.

interface.longDescription:
modoo.today skills gives ChatGPT a searchable catalog of agent skills: step-by-step instructions for real work in marketing and content, product planning and analysis, legal review and business operations (privacy, contracts, HR, finance, purchasing), industry and everyday tasks, and AI and developer workflows.

Instead of loading every instruction into the conversation, ChatGPT searches the catalog with skill_find, checks a candidate with skill_describe, and reads only the skill it needs with skill_call. When a skill carries reference files or templates, skill_read returns the one it needs, and skill_bundle lists them all.

Search ranks by meaning across languages, so a request in Korean finds a skill written in English.

Most skills are also published in our public GitHub marketplace. Some are marked sign-in only: they are served only through this app to signed-in modoo.today accounts.

All six tools are read-only. The app reads nothing from your other accounts and changes nothing anywhere. You sign in with a modoo.today account (two-step verification required); the app asks for one permission, skills:read.

positive.description: Find skills for a task described in plain words
positive.prompt: Using modoo.today skills, find a skill that helps me check a Korean privacy policy before launching an app.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching skills from the Korean legal area, led by pipa-review and terms-privacy-drafting, with what each checks. Every skill named exists in the catalog; none is invented.

positive.prompt: Show me the first page of the modoo.today skills catalog, grouped by area.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the first page of areas (packages) with the skill names and one-line descriptions under each, the total skill count, and that more pages follow.

positive.description: Open one skill and summarize its instructions
positive.prompt: Using modoo.today skills, open the tts-subtitle-sync skill and summarize its steps in five bullets.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the skill's SKILL.md and summarizes its own steps: display and spoken text pairs, getting timings, building SRT and WebVTT, timing motion, and checking. No file approval card appears.

positive.description: Read a reference file inside a skill and apply it
positive.prompt: Following the Korean example file (references/pairs.ko.md) of the tts-subtitle-sync skill in modoo.today skills, turn this sentence into display and spoken pairs as JSON: "오후 3시 30분까지 신청하면 2만 9천 원에 드려요."
positive.expected_behavior: Reads references/pairs.ko.md and returns a JSON list of {display, spoken} pairs in that file's format, with the time and price written out in Korean words on the spoken side (for example 오후 세 시 삼십 분, 이만 구천 원).

positive.description: Download every file of a skill
positive.prompt: Using modoo.today skills, download all files of the tts-subtitle-sync skill so I can save them.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches all five files of the skill (SKILL.md, references/pairs.ko.md and three Python scripts) and offers them as one ZIP to download, with the file tree and each file's purpose; checksums match the catalog. ChatGPT may ask for approval to create the files first, since the user asked to download them.

negative.description: A question outside the catalog: the plugin finds no matching skill, and the answer says so instead of presenting a skill
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Seoul tomorrow?

negative.description: Asks to run a skill's script: the plugin returns the script text but never executes code; the answer says it cannot run it and invents no timings
negative.prompt: Run the align_ctc.py script from the tts-subtitle-sync skill in modoo.today skills on my audio and give me the word timings.

negative.description: Asks for other people's activity: the plugin exposes no user data; the answer says it is not available and invents none
negative.prompt: Using modoo.today skills, show me what other users searched for today.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: find, inspect and read agent skills from the modoo.today skills catalog with six read-only tools.
